events.title: Cayucos Fall Antique Street Faire
events.venue: Ocean Ave between E St & Cayucos Dr, Cayucos
events.summary: 100+ vendors selling antiques, vintage & collectibles along Ocean Ave. Free admission & parking, food court, 7am–3pm.

events.title: Fort Vine Live at Schooners
events.summary: Fort Vine performs live at Schooners' oceanfront patio in Cayucos, part of the Beachside Live concert series.

events.title: Schooners Open Mic Night
events.summary: Free weekly open mic at Schooners' beachfront venue, open to all local & traveling musicians year-round.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic cars fill downtown Cayucos with a live band, beer garden & BBQ. Free to attend, rain or shine, 8am–4pm.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting
events.venue: Corner of D St & Ocean Ave, Downtown Cayucos
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Rotary
events.summary: Free community tree lighting with live music, carolers, Santa & Mrs. Claus arriving by fire engine, starting 5pm.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Wonderland Walk
events.summary: Festive evening stroll through decorated downtown shops with Santa visits, free horse-drawn carriage rides & kids' crafts, 4–7pm.
